messages:
Maria Gonzales: Support flagged that zephyr-mini-4b-quant model card still lists max_seq=2048 but runtime supports 4096 with quant_profile=v2. Need a short PR to update limits, add streaming/KV note, and SDK snippets.

Sophie Lee: I'll open PR. Edits: limits table -> conditional 4096 when quant_profile=v2; compatibility paragraph about streaming + enable_kv_compaction; python + TS snippets showing runtime_options and embeddings hybrid fallback; link to /docs/migrations/quant-profiles.

Ashok Patel: Bench quicks: p4d, 4096 context ~80 tok/s, p99 ~1.0s; 2048 ~135 tok/s. Uploading CSV to bench-storage.

Tanner Wu: Runtime note: recommend runtime_options.enable_kv_compaction=true for long streaming contexts to avoid recompute/oom. Add curl example.

Li Huang: I'll add TS snippet and a unit test for the streaming example.

deploy-bot: PR opened by @Sophie Lee: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 (includes bench CSV and snippets)

qa-bot: Checklist for #5120: limits table, streaming compat + curl, SDK snippets py/ts, migration link, bench CSV, test vectors under docs/samples/zephyr-mini-4b/

Sophie Lee: tagging @Ashok @Tanner @Li for review; will merge after approvals.
